landing.pitch: Fraud models check the transaction. {{product}} checks the conversation that caused it.
landing.stat: of Singapore’s scam cases in 2025 were transfers the victims made themselves.
landing.statDetail: S$913.1M lost across 41,974 cases. The device, password and OTP were all genuine, so the payments looked normal.

check.title: Check
check.body: Before a risky transfer leaves, {{product}} asks one calm question and reads the chat, screenshot or PDF behind it.

explain.title: Explain
explain.body: Gemini agents find the warning signs and point at them on the customer’s own screenshot, in their language.

protect.title: Protect
protect.body: Clear scams are held for a bank analyst, who gets the full case in real time and blocks the scammer for every customer.

landing.tryAppHint: Three demo customers, real Gemini analysis
landing.sideBySide: Best demo: open both side by side, send Mrs Tan’s transfer, and watch the case arrive.
landing.footer: Prototype for the Google Cloud AI Builder Cup 2026 · Built on Gemini, ADK, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Firestore · All data synthetic

frame.intro: A mock mobile banking app. Pick a customer, make a transfer, and {{product}} checks the conversation behind it.
frame.synthetic: All people, banks, phone numbers and accounts here are synthetic.

api.down: The API isn't answering yet. It may be waking up.

cust_001.name: Mrs Tan Mei Ling
cust_001.story: Retiree. A man who says he is from MAS tells her to move S$8,000 to a “safe account”.

cust_002.name: Raj Kumar
cust_002.story: Gig worker. A Telegram “recruiter” asks for a S$450 top-up to unlock his commission.

cust_003.name: Nur Aisyah
cust_003.story: Teacher. Pays a S$3,200 deposit to her new landlord and has the tenancy agreement.
